ticket.title: Hardcoded Language ID in getAttributesName Call Leads to Incorrect Attribute Names
ticket.bug:
Description of the Bug:

In the `AdminProductWrapper.php` file, while fetching the specific prices list for a product,  the method `getAttributesName` is called with a hardcoded parameter 1 for the language ID. 

https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/8.1.x/src/Adapter/Product/AdminProductWrapper.php#L481

This implementation assumes that language id 1 is always appropriate for fetching attribute names, which is not always the case. In scenarios where the application is being used in a multilingual context, or when the user's preferred language is different from the default language, this approach leads to incorrect attribute names being fetched and displayed. This can cause confusion for the users and potentially lead to incorrect data handling or display issues in the application. The bug essentially limits the application's flexibility and usability in multilingual environments.
ticket.expected: When i change the language of the page, the name of the attribute should be displayed in the good language.
ticket.steps:
1. Go to Product (with declianison) page in BO
2. Click Price tab
3. In the specific price list, The name will not be displayed well if the default language was different one. because it always fetches the name with id lang 1.

resolution.title: Fix: Pass correct language ID to getAttributesName instead of hardcoded 1
resolution.description: The language id param is set to 1 by default. This causes an issue in fetching the good name when changing the language in BO -> product page -> Price tab -> Specific price list. Using the language id in context should fix the issue.
resolution.how_to_test: BO -> product page -> Prix tab -> Specific price list. Create a specific price for a declinaison.  In the list, the name of declinaison will be displayed well with this fix. Before that only the name in english language will be displayed.
resolution.author: mouleeg

ticket.title: Traductions files ignored when symlink
ticket.bug:
The Finder used to search traduction files does not follow symlinks by default. Which is a major problem when working with modern and robust solutions like Deployer.

On those environments, each GIT release is in a specific folder, and the "living" files (traductions, images...) are in a common shared folder. And symlinks are made to point to the shared folder.

So for now, all the traduction files are ignored by Presta, as they are symlinks.
ticket.expected: Also parse symlinked traduction files
ticket.steps:
- Move a traduction file somewhere else on your filesystem (mainly Linux)
- make a symlink (for example: ln -fs /moved/file /original/place)
- rm Prestashop cache (rm var/cache/*/translations -Rf)
- navigate to a page
- check the traductions are no longer visible

resolution.title: Follow symlinks for traductions - Deployer best practice
resolution.description: The Finder used to search translation files does not follow symlinks by default. This is a major issue when working with modern and robust solutions like Deployer. On these environments, each GIT release is in a specific folder, and the "living" files (traductions, images...) are in a common shared folder. Symlinks are then created to point to the shared folder. Currently, all translation files are ignored by PrestaShop, as they are symlinks. This PR aims to integrate them.
resolution.how_to_test: Move a traduction file from app/Resources/translations or from your theme to somewhere else, and make a symlink to it (ie: ln -fs /moved_file /original/location)
resolution.author: Jeremie-Kiwik

ticket.title: Product Physical quantity in wrongly increased when Order status is changed
ticket.bug:
When an order placed in "Awaiting bank transfer or check payment" status is cancelled (status change) and the order is then set to "Awaiting bank transfer payment" or "Awaiting check payment" status in versions 8... (tested on 8.0.5, 8.1.1, and 8.1.5), the system increases the physical quantity. Here's an example of the incorrect behavior:

Initial stock (physical/reserved/available): 15/0/15.
Order status: Awaiting bank transfer payment -> Physical quantity: 15, Reserved quantity: 1, Available: 14.
The order is cancelled -> Physical quantity: 15, Reserved quantity: 0, Available: 15.
The order is set again to "Awaiting bank transfer payment" or "Awaiting check payment" -> Physical quantity: 16, Reserved quantity: 1, Available: 15.

This incorrect behavior is observed in versions 8... of Prestashop and leads to an incorrect increase in the physical quantity reserved when an order is cancelled and modified again to the "Awaiting bank transfer payment" or "Awaiting check payment" status. It's not acceptable for stock levels to increase in this way; if, for example, an employee mistakenly changes the status to cancelled and then reverts to the initial status, the physical quantity will have increased.
ticket.expected: I expected that when an order is cancelled and then set back to the "Awaiting bank transfer payment" or "Awaiting check payment" status in Prestashop 8.x, the system should not increase the physical quantity. Instead, the physical quantity should remain the same as before the cancellation.
ticket.steps:
1. Place an order in Prestashop 8.x and set the status to "Awaiting bank transfer payment" or "Awaiting check payment".
2. Verify the initial stock levels (physical/reserved/available).
3. Cancel the order.
4. Confirm that the physical quantity remains the same after cancellation.
5. Set the order status back to "Awaiting bank transfer payment" or "Awaiting check payment".
6. Verify the stock levels again and observe that the physical quantity has increased incorrectly.

resolution.title: Fix quantity misadjustment on status change from Canceled to any non-loggable
resolution.description: Fixes the stock issue where the physical quantity was incorrectly increased when an order's status changed from a _Canceled_ or _Payment error_ state to any non-loggable state. More details below.

ticket.title: MariaDB Incompatibility
ticket.bug:
I am using MariaDB and tried to run the behavioural test suite and get several errors. Around 12 errors are related to a problem with the database and all of the same kind:

````
001 Scenario: one product in cart, quantity 1, can apply only the cart rule which is restricted to selected carrier # Features/Scenario/Cart/CartRule/FrontOffice/carrier.feature:160
      And I save all the restrictions for cart rule cartrule7                                                       # Features/Scenario/Cart/CartRule/FrontOffice/carrier.feature:173
        An exception occurred while executing 'DELETE FROM ps_cart_rule_carrier crc WHERE crc.id_cart_rule = ?' with params [3]:
        
        SQLSTATE[42000]: Syntax error or access violation: 1064 You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MariaDB server version for the right syntax to use near 'crc WHERE crc.id_cart_rule = '3'' at line 1 (Doctrine\DBAL\Exception\SyntaxErrorException)
````

The cause is, that MariaDB is not supporting an alias for the `DELETE` statement. Minimal test:

````
MariaDB [test_prestashop]> DELETE FROM ps_prodcut xy WHERE id_product=123123;
ERROR 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MariaDB server version for the right syntax to use near 'xy WHERE id_product=123123' at line 1
```` 

I can find a few places where the alias feature is used, but these seem not covered by the automated tests.

When I search MariaDB in the issues, 19 issues are shown. From this, I conclude, that MariaDB is used with PrestaShop and thought to be working. Looking through the issues briefly, I haven't found an indication that MariaDB is not to be used.

The CI tests run only with MySQL.
ticket.expected:
I suggest to do the following, instantly:
- update the documentation stating that: "Only MySQL is fully supported and tested. MariaDB users could run into issues and should report a bug"
- Add a field in the bug report with the database type and version

If MariaDB should be supported, it needs to be added to the CI tests in the long run I think.

Since the problem seems minor and I know what to do now, I will stay with MariaDB in our environment and send some patches.
ticket.steps: Run the behavioural tests with MariaDB

resolution.title: Removed useless aliases which cause issue with MariaDB
resolution.description: Aliases on table in DELETE queries aren't compatible with MariaDB

ticket.title: 'Version' param from registerJavascript and registerStylesheet break CCC
ticket.bug:
When registering a JavaScript script using `registerJavascript` with a `version` parameter and enabling CCC (Combine, Compress, and Cache) for JavaScript, the generated 'bottom-*.js' file breaks. Instead of including the minified file content, the full path with the version is added to the bottom file. Consequently, this leads to JavaScript errors that disrupt the functionality of all shop JavaScript components.

![image](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/89129201/decf9c32-7c42-4a01-93ba-6da86a316954)

![image](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/89129201/f19349fc-2f91-498a-b12a-f67d609a0c88)



```
$this->context->controller->registerJavascript(
            'module-' . $this->name . '-shop-js',
            'modules/' . $this->name . '/views/js/shop.js',
            [
                'version' => $this->version,
            ]
        );
```

It also does the same with CCC for CSS and registerStylesheet.

While examining the code and the documentation, I also noticed something noteworthy:

- On [this doc page](https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/8/themes/getting-started/asset-management/), the parameter `attributes` is mentioned.
- However, in [this line of code](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/de990c7031a7833b1d7572f67105b16bae3c6723/classes/assets/CccReducer.php#L108), the parameter is referred to as `attribute`. I realized this because my code previously had `'attribute' => 'async'`, and yet the issue persisted (while the asset should have been ignored if I understood the code correctly). Hence, there may also be a discrepancy regarding this matter.

Many thanks to @NicoVmax who spent some time helping me and who found that the problem was with the 'version' parameter.

@NicoVmax tried this on PS 1.7 and could not reproduce the issue. So maybe it's a regression...
ticket.expected: The 'bottom-*.js' file should include the minified content of the JavaScript script registered with registerJavascript, regardless of whether a version parameter is provided.
ticket.steps:
1. Enable CCC for JavaScript in the PrestaShop backend.
2. Register a JavaScript script in a module using registerJavascript with a version parameter.
3. Observe the generated 'bottom-*.js' file, noticing the inclusion of the full path with the version instead of the minified file content.
4. Attempt to execute JavaScript functionalities in the shop (product popups, ...), resulting in errors due to the broken script inclusion.

ticket.title: Impossible to download PDF invoice for guest order
ticket.bug:
I'm creating this issue for @Hlavtox.

What's wrong?
- When you want to download an invoice via a standardized link `https://www.domain.com/index.php?controller=pdf-invoice&id_order=XXXX&secure_key=XXXX`, it doesn't work sometimes.
- The condition now says this: `if there is a customer in context and it doesn't match the order customer OR the secure key doesn't match`, die.
- So now if you have a perfectly legit link with secure_key, but you are logged in as different customer or start a guest checkout, the link won't work.
- So the fix is easy, die only if both of these fail:
  - If there is a customer in context and it's not the customer of the order.
  - If there isn't a secure key in the link.
ticket.expected: I should be able to download the invoice.
ticket.steps:
- Make sure that some guest order exists in a shop and invoice is available for it.
- Go to FO, make sure you are logged out. Start a checkout as a guest (without password), no need to fill any addresses.
- Now go to guest tracking and try to track the order and try to download an invoice.
- You will get white screen and `The invoice was not found.`.
- Same situation is when you are logged in in FO as a different customer and you have the link to the invoice in the mail for example.

resolution.title: Fix invoice download for non logged in customer
resolution.description: You can't download an invoice sometimes, if you are not logged in. This fixes it. Interesting that nobody in the huge community found it in like 13 years. :-)))
resolution.author: Hlavtox

ticket.title: Backup changes data
ticket.bug:
When you make a backup in the Prestashop backoffice it modifies the data that you save by replacing some empty strings with NULL values. Note that this applies to the independent function (advanced settings->database: second tab). The automatic backup during an upgrade uses different code.

In the database the fields isbn, upc and mpn in the ps_product table are declared as default NULL. However, when Prestashop creates products it gives them an empty string value. Yet the backup procedure takes the NULL default as excuse to change empty strings into NULLs.

The problem is that when you do have these values filled with NULL product edit in the backofffice will not work and create a ProductDetails construct crash (see image) with the message: _Argument 2 passed to PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Domain\Product\QueryResult\ProductDetails::__construct() must be of the type string, null given, called in \src\Adapter\Product\QueryHandler\GetProductForEditingHandler.php on line 405_
![nulls](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/13930107/84e9feee-fa4c-42aa-9365-1ba1035d6494)

One situation where this arises is when you make a backup in the backoffice. The backup will look at the field definition and replace empty fields with NULL values.
ticket.expected: Consist behavior that doesn't cause a crash.
ticket.steps:
Make a backup of a PS 8.1 installation. 
Restore the backup and use it as the database.
Edit one of the products

resolution.title: Fix backup tool creating nulls
resolution.description: This PR fixes an issue when the prestashop backup was adding NULLs to columns, where there is an empty string. If you restore this database, you get errors in admin. More info below.
resolution.how_to_test: Create backup in prestashop backoffice, restore it in phpMyAdmin, see that backoffice product page works normally. :-)
resolution.author: Hlavtox

ticket.title: PS 8.1.1 break BC with ObjectModel having translatable bool fields
ticket.bug: Since Prestashop 8.1.1 loading an ObjectModel with a boolean field that is translatable triggers an 'Array to string conversion' error.

ObjectModel with translatable boolean must load properly.

resolution.title: Prevent uncheck cast
resolution.description: Previous modification in EntityMapper introduced a breaking change when having a boolean field  with `'lang' => true` on an ObjectModel. ticket.title: Unit price of combination of zero-priced product is considered zero even if it is not
ticket.expected:
The Product object should calculate the unit price as the sum of the product unit price and the combination unit price impact, and only then it should test it for zero value. Which will pass along a non-zero unit price if any of the two components is non-zero.

- product: Hummingbird notebook (ID: 18)
- product price: 0
- unit product: 0
- combination: Paper Type - Ruled (ID: 36)

- unit price impact: 1 euro
- unity: kg (heavy notebook, IKR :smile: )

resolution.title: Fix combination unit price math
resolution.description: Fix for the Product::computeUnitPriceRatio() by removing non-zero conditions for summing the product unit price and the combination unit price impact, which made final unit price zero even if one of its components (product unit price and combination unit price impact) was not zero.

ticket.title: Persian alphabets changes to English in the URL
ticket.bug:
I upgraded my PrestaShop store, which was in Persian, from 1.7.8.9 to 8.1.1 and found out all the URLs have been changed to English, I have "Accented URL" enabled in the "Traffic & SEO > SEO & URLs menu". We always have to enable this option when we want to have Persian URLs (products, categories, etc.).

I never had this problem in PS 1.6 or 1.7, You would just enable that option and start creating your products with Persian names and friendly URLs, and that's how it should work. Something has changed in PS8 which is absolutely wrong and it's a serious problem for shops that are in Persian.

Here is an example of the changed URL:

Original URL:
`site.com/1-پوشاک-مردانه`

New (**Wrong**) URL:
`site.com/1-pwshak-mrdanh`

It changes every charchter to English, one by one:
پوشاک -> pwshak
پ -> p
و -> w
ش -> sh
ا -> a
ک -> k

The main problem is that URL fields have been changed in the BO. So even if I disable the Accented URL, I can't get my old URLs back, unless there is an option to revert these changes.
ticket.expected: It shouldn't convert Persian Charchter to English when "Accented URL" is enabled. I want my URLs to be in Persian.
ticket.steps:
1. Install PS in Persian (Farsi), or add the Persian language to PS 8.1.1.
2. Enable the Accented URL in the SEO & URLs menu.
3. Create a product combi and write a Persian Name for it. (You can Try "فارسی" which is "Farsi").)

Previous edit: (3. Create a category/product and write a Persian Name for it. (You can Try "فارسی" which is "Farsi").)

(I'm not sure how/when this change applies, I think it takes time to change the URL, or maybe it's related to some sort of cache.)

resolution.title: Fix URL with accented chars
resolution.description: We no longer took PS_ALLOW_ACCENTED_CHARS_URL into account when switching to 8.1
resolution.author: M0rgan01

ticket.title: Cannot set specific price with currency filter
ticket.bug:
When setting specific price for a product, if (non default) currency is used in filter, it's not possible to enter new price in "target" currency.

The table shows like it's been set properly, see:

resolution.title: Cannot set specific price with currency filter

ticket.title: URL Alternate with unwanted parameters
ticket.bug:
Hello,

I have just discovered an embarrassing SEO bug, which multiplies the number of existing URLs for a page.

This bug concerns the ModuleFrontController (and function hookModuleRoutes) with several languages which are activated on the Prestashop. 

When there is a well-declared rewrite at the module level, such as for the SmartBlog module, the URL generates well with the URL rewrite. However, when Prestashop generates "alternate" URLs, it goes back to the "sanitizeUrl" function, which adds the parameters that are supposed to be hidden.

Here is an example :
```html
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="fr-fr" href="http://www.test.local/fr/blog/category/15_des-conseils.html?slug=des-conseils&module=smartblog">

ticket.title: Deleting !LoadedObject Customer deletes all CartRules that don't have customer restrictions
ticket.bug:
This does not happen in regular use but happens when someone (me) does integration without checking everything all the time (which is way too easy)

Take this code:

```php
$Customer = new Customer(-1);
$Customer->delete();
```

delete does not complain anything BUT there is a side effect!

Customer::delete https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/65e20f37cfe40d4ad47480ada09c4fc45a4fa0f0/classes/Customer.php#L416

Does `CartRule::deleteByIdCustomer((int) $this->id);` but because the Customer was not really loaded (id -1 does not exists) the Customer object id is `null` but casting null to int makes it zero...

https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/65e20f37cfe40d4ad47480ada09c4fc45a4fa0f0/classes/CartRule.php#L614

`deleteByIdCustomer` does not check for 0 being a case and selects all CartRules where id_customer==0 and happily deletes them.
ticket.expected:
* Calling $Object->delete() when object is not valid loaded object should fail.
* `deleteByIdCustomer` should never be able to delete CartRules that do not have Customer condition set (e.g id_customer is 0)
ticket.steps:
1. Create CartRules with and withourt customer conditions
2. run the code above

=> all CartRules that didn't have customer conditions set are deleted

resolution.title: Prevent removing non restricted cart rules
resolution.description: Prevents removing non-restricted cart rules by passing zero as customer ID.
resolution.how_to_test: Create some cart rules without customer restriction, call `CartRule::deleteByIdCustomer(0);`
resolution.author: Hlavtox

ticket.title: Unexpected behaviour with DateTimeColumn empty value
ticket.bug:
When you use a DateTimeColumn in a Grid, you're able to define a value to display in case the DateTimeColumn value would be empty, thanks to the empty_data parameter. Empty_data parameter is by default set to an empty string.

When passing an empty value to this column type, the current datetime is displayed.
ticket.expected: The expected behaviour, is that if the DateTimeColumn receives an empty data, it displays an empty string, or the defined empty_data parameter's value.
ticket.steps:
Add or use any DateTimeColumn in a Grid. 
Pass it an empty value (false, null, 0, "", ...).
Check that it renders the current datetime instead of the empty_data parameter's value.

resolution.title: Update date_time.html.twig better check for emptiness
resolution.description: Date_time column type allows to declare a specific data to display in case its data would be empty. However, it only checks if the date is a default value ('0000-00-00 00:00:00') and not if it is "empty" (false, null, "", ...). This PR adds a emptiness check in the template, as giving an empty data would result in the current datetime being displayed and this is not correct.
resolution.how_to_test: In the OrderQueryBuilder class, in the getSearchQueryBuilder, replace 'o.date_add' by 'null as date_add'. Now you can check that it displays an empty string instead of current datetime.

ticket.title: Profiler shows incorrect execution time
ticket.bug:
When using the Profiler, I notice that the execution time is wrong.
In fact the start_time is when `Profiler::__construct` is called https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/ff3780e47ad5ff031440c6856f6ec031801de0d3/tools/profiling/Profiler.php#L76,
but it should be the start of the request, when `index.php` is starting to execute.

![Immagine 2023-05-30 153824](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/7520695/82cb86cf-c377-4b68-b386-7ece557efb30)

In this image, the three numbers displayed at the top are `{$smarty.server.REQUEST_TIME_FLOAT} {$run.startTime}
  {load_time data=($run.startTime - $smarty.server.REQUEST_TIME_FLOAT)}` added in https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/tools/profiling/templates/run.tpl

This proves that there are 91ms that are used by the initialisation of Prestashop before `Profiler::__construct()`
ticket.expected:
In the profiler, the time should start to run when the script starts executing.
This would be the good starting time on which the calculations for the profiler should be base on: https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/ff3780e47ad5ff031440c6856f6ec031801de0d3/config/config.inc.php#L38
If the server exposes the variable `$_SERVER['REQUEST_TIME_FLOAT']`, then this would also be a good candidate as start time.


The correct value for `config` Time in the image above should be 5.611ms + 91.627ms = 97.238ms
ticket.steps:
1. Enable profiling in `defines_custom.inc.php` by adding `define('_PS_DEBUG_PROFILING_', true);`
2. In https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/ff3780e47ad5ff031440c6856f6ec031801de0d3/tools/profiling/templates/run.tpl#L26, before the `<table>` add `{$smarty.server.REQUEST_TIME_FLOAT} {$run.startTime}
  {load_time data=($run.startTime - $smarty.server.REQUEST_TIME_FLOAT)}`
3. Load a page in the front end and look at the output of the Profiler

resolution.title: Profiler: measure execution time from the beginning.
resolution.description: Currently the Profiler measures execution time since the call to `Profiler::__cunstruct()`. We need a beter estimate. If the server exposes the variable `$_SERVER['REQUEST_TIME_FLOAT']`, use it, else use the `$start_time` from https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/2aaa49f97f372a0efe8e91bdba045ff3617ee5c2/config/config.inc.php#L38
resolution.how_to_test: Look at #32753 to see the changes
resolution.author: lmeyer1

ticket.title: Incorrect condition disallows use of index `date_add` on table `ps_connections`
ticket.bug:
The display of the Carts page in the BO takes a lot of time (often it delays after the timeout of 300 s). The query used is 

```
SELECT a.`id_cart`, a.`date_add` AS `date_add` , CONCAT(LEFT(c.`firstname`, 1), '. ', c.`lastname`) `customer`, a.id_cart total, ca.name carrier, o.id_order, IF ( IFNULL(o.id_order, 'Non commandé') = 'Non commandé', IF(TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF('2023-03-03 09:08:00', a.`date_add`)) > 86400, 'Panier abandonné', 'Non commandé'), o.id_order ) AS status, IF(o.id_order, 1, 0) badge_success, IF(o.id_order, 0, 1) badge_danger, IF(co.id_guest, 1, 0) id_guest, shop.name as shop_name 
FROM `ps_cart` a 
LEFT JOIN ps_customer c ON (c.id_customer = a.id_customer) 
LEFT JOIN ps_currency cu ON (cu.id_currency = a.id_currency) 
LEFT JOIN ps_carrier ca ON (ca.id_carrier = a.id_carrier) 
LEFT JOIN ps_orders o ON (o.id_cart = a.id_cart) 
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT `id_guest` FROM `ps_connections` 
WHERE TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF('2023-03-03 09:08:00', `date_add`)) < 1800 ) AS co ON co.`id_guest` = a.`id_guest` 
LEFT JOIN `ps_shop` shop ON a.`id_shop` = shop.`id_shop` 
WHERE 1 AND a.id_shop IN (20) ORDER BY a.id_cart DESC LIMIT 0, 50;
```
Notice the inner select `SELECT DISTINCT id_guest FROM ps_connections WHERE TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF('2023-03-03 09:08:00', date_add)) < 1800`. The table ps_connections does have an index on the field `date_add`, but with this condition it cannot be used. In fact the calculation must be executed for each of the lines in ps_connections (these can be tens or hundreds of thousnad).
ticket.expected:
The condition in the query should be turned around in a way that the calculation is only done once. For instance: 
```
`date_add` > date_add(now(), interval -30 minute))
```
That way the index `date_add` on the table `ps_connections` can be used and the query time drops into fractions of a second.
ticket.steps:
1. In the BO, navigate to `Orders - Carts`
2. Notice that the page takes a long time to load.

Note: my `ps_connections` table has 2M+ rows

resolution.title: Use index for connections.date_add
resolution.description: Fixes an inefficient query. Use index instead of full table scan, 1 math operation per query instead of 1 per row.
resolution.how_to_test: Displaying the list of Carts in the BO still works the same, but MUCH faster (0.5s instead of minutes)
resolution.author: lmeyer1

ticket.title: Translation locale override doesn't work if translation is missing for default language
ticket.bug: If you pass the optional `$locale` parameter to `trans()`, the function still returns the translation in the default language unless a translation also exists in the default language in the database. So if your default locale is English but you want your translation to always show up in Finnish, the translation needs to exist in both languages in the database for it to show up in Finnish.
ticket.expected:
The translation should be returned in the desired language regardless of whether a translation exists in the default one.

This used to work in PrestaShop versions <8.0.1.
ticket.steps:
1. Download and install [this test module](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/10901709/localetest.zip)
2. Set your back office language to English
3. Download and install the Finnish language pack OR modify the trans() function call in the test module to use another language that you already have installed
4. Translate the test string (in domain "Modules.Localetest.Test") to Finnish or the language you used for the override (you can translate it to whatever, the string just needs to be different)
5. DO NOT translate the test string in English
6. Go to the test module configuration page and see that the test string is still in English

resolution.title: Take locale into account when deciding whether module translation should fall back to the legacy system
resolution.description: Locale (if given) isn't currently taken into account when checking whether the translation catalog contains a given message, so the translation has to exist in both the desired and the default language for the string to be translated.

resolution.title: Fix order notes not being saved
resolution.description: in the object model, the field was of type string, instead of HTML, keeping notes with HTML brackets like `<mynote>` from being stored, because a strip tag was applied. ticket.title: In module configuration pages, the "Activate module for this shop context" checkbox does not work
ticket.bug:
When the multistore option is activated and at least two shops have been created, a new panel is displayed at the bottom of module configuration pages, containing a checkbox labeled "Activate module for this shop context". Checking/unchecking this checkbox is supposed to enable/disable the current module for the current shop context.

This does not currently work. Accessing a module's configuration page from a context where it is disabled and clicking  the checkbox to activate it just reloads the page, leaving the module deactivated and reseting the checkbox to its unchecked state.
ticket.expected: Checking the box should systematically enable the module for the current context, and unchecking it should disable it.
ticket.steps:
1. Activate the multistore feature if disabled, in Parameters > General > Enable Multistore
2. Access Multistore in Advanced Parameters and create one if only one exists
3. Install a module that has a configuration page, like the Contact form module for example
4. Access its configuration page from the context of a shop where it's enabled, and then swap to the new shop
5. It will show as disabled by default. Check the "Activate module for this shop context" box.
6. The page reloads showing the checkbox unchecked, and the module is still disabled in this context

resolution.title: Fix module activation checkbox in module configuration pages
resolution.description: When the multishop option is activated and at least two shops have been created, a new panel is displayed at the bottom of module configuration pages, containing a checkbox labeled "Activate module for this shop context". Checking/unchecking this checkbox is supposed to enable/disable the current module for the current shop context.  This does not currently work. Clicking this box reloads the current url, adding an "enable" parameter with a value of 0 or 1 depending on if it is checked or not. Getting the status of the checkbox is achieved via the jquery .attr() method, which since jQuery 1.6 cannot be used for attributes like "checked" or "disabled". As a result "enable" is set to 0 wether the box is checked or not.  The solution is to use jQuery's .is(':checked') method instead.
resolution.how_to_test: 1. Activate the multistore feature if disabled, in Parameters > General > Enable Multistore  2. Access Multistore in Advanced Parameters and create one if only one exists  3. Install a module that has a configuration page, like the Contact form module for example  4. Access its configuration page from the context of a shop where it's enabled, and then swap to the new shop  5. It will show as disabled by default. Check the "Activate module for this shop context" box.  6. The page reloads showing the checkbox checked, and the module enabled in this context
resolution.author: IcarusSosie

ticket.title: Using `png_all` option in BO, all images should have transparent background in FO
ticket.bug:
This is somewhere between a bug and an improvement.

When choosing `Use PNG for all images` (`png_all`) as Image format (in menu *Design - Image Settings*), the background is transparent when the original image is in png format and white otherwise.
ticket.expected:
I expect both images to be visually the same, with a transparent border. The output format is png for both, because we 
have choosen *Use PNG for all images* (`png_all`), therefore both should have a transparent border.

This would allow for more flexibility for the design of the templates. Also it makes more sense to always make use of the advantages the png format offers when we choose *Use PNG for all images* (`png_all`), and not make the use of transparency dependent on the source format.
ticket.steps:
1. Use these two images. [test_images.zip] One is in png format, and one is in jpg format (https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/6279138/test_images.zip)
2. In menu *Improve - Design - Image Settings*, under *Image generation options*
    for *Image format* choose *Use PNG for all images*
    for *Generate images based on one side of the source image* choose *Automatic (longest size)*
3. Upload both images into a product.
4. Go to the image folder and inspect the generated images.

resolution.title: When saving an image as a square png, add always a transparent border
resolution.description: Transparency of thumbnail images only depends on output file format, not input file format. That means, if we load a product image from a rectangular jpg file, the square thumbnail mast have a transparent border, as if it was a png.
resolution.how_to_test: Set image settings to *Use PNG for all images* and *Automatic (longest size)*, then import a rectangular image in `jpg` format. The thumbnails must have transparent borders.
resolution.author: lmeyer1

ticket.title: PNG thumbnails are not regenerated automatically, if missing
ticket.steps:
1. Go to your Prestashop image settings and set image format to "Use PNG if original file is PNG".
2. A) Make a product, name it "JPG Product", upload few images in JPG format.
2. B) Make a product, name it "PNG Product," upload few images in PNG format.
3. A) Find id_image of one JPG image, go to /img/p/X/X/X/X/X/ and delete all thumbnails. Do not delete XXXXX.jpg, filetype and index.php.
3. B) Find id_image of one PNG image, go to /img/p/X/X/X/X/X/ and delete all thumbnails. Do not delete XXXXX.jpg, filetype and index.php.
4. A) Open JPG Product, see all images correctly. Check /img/p/X/X/X/X/X/ folder and see all thumbnails go back.
4. B) Open PNG Product, images are gone and not regenerated.

resolution.title: Fix thumbnail regeneration for files other than jpg
resolution.description: When importing an image, Prestashop saves it always with id_image as name and the extension `.jpg` regardless of the format (e.g. `123.jpg`). It also saves a file named `fileType` along the image file. When `ImageRetriever::getImage()` attemps to resize the file, it will not look for `123.jpg`, but instead for a file with the extension saved in `fileType` (e.g. `123.png`). This latter does not exists, and the thumbnail generation fails. There are two possible fixes:  - Always save the images with the correct extension  - Always look for a file `id_image.jpg` and ignore `fileType`  Since all the rest of Prestashop assumes that images have always an extension `.jpg` (e.g. in URL rewriting), the first option, would need a very heavy lifting.  I opted for the second, even though it perpetuates the principle that every image has a `jpg` extension, and that I personally strongly dislike.
resolution.how_to_test: - Go in the image directory of an image with type png  - Delete all thumbnails, but not the file `fileType`  - Display the product in the FO  Without the fix, the thumbnail do not regenerate. With the fix it works.
resolution.author: lmeyer1

ticket.title: Cache folders are duplicated
ticket.bug: Few last versions of prestashop has been creating both `prod` and `pro_` folders in _var/cache/_. It seems also `dev` and `de_` are being created. What is that all about?

ticket.steps:

2. Check _var/cache/_

resolution.title: Let Symfony handle kernel reboot
resolution.description: Since #21429 has been merged, when the cache gets cleared, a new folder in `var/cache/` is created where the kernel warms up but is never used then. The command `cache:clear` can be used with the option `--no-optional-warmers` that will only reboot the kernel without warming optional cache as `SymfonyCacheClearer` was mean to do.
resolution.how_to_test: Try to install/uninstall `ps_facebook`, no `de_` or `pro_` folder should be present in the `/var/cache/` folder.
resolution.author: atomiix

ticket.title: [RE-order] No notification when an error occurs
ticket.bug:
I noticed that when a customer wanted to reorder one of his orders, but one of the products was out of stock, he was redirected to the home without having the reason for this redirection. 

By diving into the code, I notice that the duplication of the basket fail due to the OOS of a product, this problem generates an error that is put in $this->errors, but it will not appear in front.
ticket.expected: If an error is generated during the duplication of the cart, we should be redirected to the home page with an error in front so that the customer is aware of the reason.
ticket.steps:
1. Create an order with multiple product
2. Set the quantity of one of the products to 0
3. Go to your order history as a customer
4. Click on "reorder".

resolution.title: Add redirect with notifications
resolution.description: When you do a reorder with OOS products, there are too many redirects that you lose the error.  Indeed, the duplication of the basket generates an error in `$this-errors[] ` which is not displayed during the redirection on the index.
resolution.how_to_test: Try to re-encode an order with 1 OOS products with a refusal on the add cart. You will be redirected to the index with no apparent error message. After the fix, you will see the message.
resolution.author: Lionel-dev

` is HTML-escaped - In Doubles, the placeholders' HTML is also escaped See screenshots: ![2021-11-23_165341](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143445824-f3ead5e9-55e3-40bc-90f9-9a8398a5e602.jpg) ![2021-11-23_165407](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143445686-cddf68ad-1660-4cbb-8940-2bf2642434f9.jpg)

The display should be corrected as follows: - In Stopwatch SQL display the times as milliseconds and add digits after the comma to keep precision. - In Stopwatch SQL, do not escape `
` - In Doubles, do not escape the placeholders Screenshots : ![2021-11-23_165831](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143445860-63f46611-9d2a-4050-b624-808db85e3575.jpg) ![2021-11-23_165757](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143445853-19d4fab0-6d99-442c-8997-5ffac7717065.jpg)

ticket.title: Footer from next invoice shown on invoice when exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range)
ticket.bug: When exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range), the footer of the following invoice is shown on the current invoice erroneously. This meant that in a multi-store environment, the wrong store details could be output on the invoice footer, which can create a compliance issue, especially if different tax information should be displayed. The issue resolves around the use of TCPDF, where the footer needs to be output after AddPage, otherwise the last page of a page group will end up having the footer of the next page group.
ticket.steps:
Steps to reproduce the behaviour:

1. In a multi-store environment -- set up multiple stores with different data, such that the footers on invoices would differ depending on which store items were ordered from
2. Place and invoice a mixture of orders - switch between stores when placing orders
3. Export orders using the invoices by date range functionality
4. Where invoices switch between stores, the footer belonging to the store of the next invoice will be shown on the current invoice

I will submit a pull request with a fix.

resolution.title: Footer from next invoice shown on invoice when exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range)
resolution.description: When exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range), the footer of the following invoice is shown on the current invoice erroneously. This meant that in a multi-store environment, the wrong store details could be output on the invoice footer, which can create a compliance issue, especially if different tax information should be displayed. The issue resolves around the use of TCPDF, where the footer needs to be output after AddPage, otherwise the last page of a page group will end up having the footer of the next page group.
resolution.how_to_test: 1. In a multi-store environment -- set up multiple stores with different data, such that the footers on invoices would differ depending on which store items were ordered from 2. Place and invoice a mixture of orders - switch between stores when placing orders 3. Export orders using the invoices by date range functionality 4. Where invoices switch between stores, the footer should always be relative to the store the invoice is from
resolution.author: AshleyButcher

ticket.title: Warning on line 1021 in file /prestashop/controllers/admin/AdminCustomerThreadsController.php [2] count(): Parameter must be an array or an object that implements Countable
ticket.bug:
When saving the imap settings on the backend customer service page the following error is shown.

`Warning on line 1021 in file /prestashop/controllers/admin/AdminCustomerThreadsController.php [2] count(): Parameter must be an array or an object that implements Countable`

LINE 1014 = `$errors = imap_errors()` 
this returns a boolean when there are no errors.

LINE 1021 = `if (count($errors) && is_array($errors) {` _[current code]_
This is because the IF-statement which checks the $errors array is in the wrong order.
If nothing is returned from imap_errors() then $errors becomes a boolean which isn't countable

Changing LINE 1021 fixes the issue 
`if (is_array($errors) && count($errors))  {` _[fix code]_
 -> switching the 2 options of the IF-statement
ticket.steps:
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to 'Customer Service' in the backend
2. Setup IMAP settings & Save
3. Revisit the 'Customer Service' page
4. See error

resolution.description: wrong check for the errors

resolution.title: Fetch and set logo image size inside template

It required to adjust json-ld where logo was fetched from `$shop.logo`.    We are changing `$shop.logo` variable from `string` to `array` and it is breaking change. Themes and module that are using `$shop.logo` as src logo will have to change it to `$shop.logo.src`.

ticket.title: jQuery UI overrides bootstrap tooltip component
ticket.bug: When modules adds jQuery UI library (for example ps_searchbar, ps_facetedsearch), it is included in template due to higher priority after theme.js where bootstrap library is included. Bootstrap and jQuery UI uses $.fn.tooltip method for their tooltip components. When jQuery UI is included it overrides bootstrap tooltip method.
ticket.expected: JQuery UI should be included before theme.js file. To prevent it from overriding bootstrap tooltip component.
ticket.steps: Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Go to product page. 2. Open `themes/classic/templates/catalog/product.tpl` and place there inside `{block name='page_header_container'}` block. ``` tooltip hover me ``` 3. Open `themes/classic/assets/js/custom.js` and paste this code: ``` $(() => { $('[data-toggle="tooltip"]').tooltip(); }) ``` 4. Go back to product page and hover on that span. Tooltip should appear with white background and box-shadow (it is jQuery UI tooltip). 5. Go BO and disable ps_searchbar module. 6. Go back to product page and refresh. 7. Hover on span and red tooltip should appear. (it is bootstrap tooltip).

resolution.title: Change jQuery-ui position before theme.js to avoid overriding bootstrap ones
resolution.description: Bootstrap tooltips were overridden by JQuery-ui one which make it difficult to style it with Bootstrap variables
resolution.author: NeOMakinG

ticket.title: Smarty Modifier Classname - compatibility with CSS BEM method
ticket.bug:
I am facing an issue with using the CSS BEM method with the Smarty Classnames Modifier.

The function removes the double dashes, except it is the method to make "modify" classes in CSS BEM
ticket.expected: The original CSS classes
ticket.steps:

1. Create a template with the following smarty tag: `{['block__elem' => true, 'block__elem--mod' => true]|classnames}`

**Screenshots**

resolution.title: Smarty Modifier Classname - compatibility with CSS BEM method
resolution.description: I am facing an issue with using the [CSS BEM method](http://getbem.com/naming/) with the Smarty Classnames Modifier. The function removes the double dashes, except it is the method to make "modifier" classes in CSS BEM. I am proposing an improvement, which adds the possibility of using this class format while keeping the previous security.
resolution.how_to_test: You can test with the [documentation](https://devdocs.prestashop.com/1.7/development/components/smarty-extensions/#classname) class and with the following class: block__elem--mod

ticket.title: Smarty template caching Module::isCached() faulty causes performance loss
ticket.bug:
Prestashop class **Module** (`Prestashop /classes/module/Module.php`) has a function called **isCached** to check if tpl file is cached. This function fails to check and returns **false** while tpl is cached. 

Commit https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/13804

Person who made PR was fixing issue #9763 and modified Module's class function **fetch** adding this:

```
if ($compile_id === null) {
            $compile_id = Context::getContext()->shop->theme->getName();
        }
```
Because of this change when you call **fetch** function with **$compile_id = null** it generates smarty cache file under $compile_id directory which is theme name in this case (if $compile_id is null then $compile_id is set to theme name).

But when you try to check if template is cached with function **isCached** with **$compile_id = null** you always get **false** because code added in **fetch** function should be also added to **isCached** function.

Templates are fetched (cached) under compile_id which is theme name in most cases, but isCached function checks if template is cached with empty compile_id which causes false result.

**This bug causes a huge performance issues.** Many plugins check if tpl is cached and if not - they perform data aggregation and assignation for smarty to render tpl but actually is not needed.

resolution.title: Fix performance issue on Smarty template caching
resolution.description: From 1.7.7.0 version Module class function isCached fails to check if tpl is cached. This PR fixes that.
resolution.how_to_test: In order to test if it is fixed you need to check if function isCached works properly or try to reproduce issue. How to reproduce issue is described in issue ticket.
resolution.author: lukaslau

ticket.title: The product-list on the checkout does not work with custom themes
ticket.bug:
This fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 breaks the "Add to cart" buttons in the product-list in all custom themes.

Short movie:
https://www.loom.com/share/1ed22057f0964fee84eaaf9bcc73a3c9


Fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 adds to core.js this code to disable the "Add to cart" button:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

The problem is that all custom themes use this code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"
to add the "Add to cart" button in the product-list, which means that after an update to 1.7.8.x all shops with custom themes will have this problem and it is difficult to fix it directly in the theme.

You can go here:
https://addons.prestashop.com/en/3-templates-prestashop
open any theme and check the source code of the "Add to cart" button in the product-list to see that all themes use in the product-list that code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"
ticket.expected:
The "Add to cart" button should be disabled only on the product page in the form:
form#add-to-cart-or-refresh

In means that this code in the core.js:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

should be replaced with something as this:
$('form#add-to-cart-or-refresh [data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

or this code should be removed from core.js and added to /themes/classic/assets/js/theme.js
ticket.steps:
1.Install a custom theme with the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

2.Click the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

resolution.title: Install theme before modules
resolution.description: When the theme is installed, it uses the `theme.yml` file to know which modules are required for the theme and to which hooks they must be attached to. Once the install process has this info, it will unhook every modules that are hooked to hooks listed in the `theme.yml` so only theme-related modules are hooked on those hooks. By installing the modules not already installed by the theme **after** the theme, this limitation goes away.
resolution.author: atomiix

ticket.title: When an Exception is thrown with a string code, there is a fatal error
ticket.bug: Like DBPdo that will throw this error: - SQLSTATE[42S22]: Column not found: 1054 Unknown column '%s' in 'where clause'" - Error code: 42S22 As you can see, the error code is not an integer but a string. As we have a strict type and that Exception need an int as the $code paramterers, it's throw a fatal error.
ticket.steps:
1. Make a select with a missing colum into the where clause (use DbQuery for that)
2. See the fatal error

---

1. Install this module [test.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/8464689/test.zip)
2. Go to FO
3. See error

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23308427/162754674-70124d66-6700-4462-8e77-052f7e8bde9f.png)

resolution.title: Wrap PDOException in PrestaShopException to cast the string error code to an int
resolution.description: `\PDOException` is the only `\Exception`'s child that can return a string for the method `getCode()` but there is places where we try to wrap the `\PDOException` in another exception, using `getCode()` of the `\PDOException` to construct the new exception. Starting with PHP 8.0, this is not possible anymore, we should pass an int. This PR solve it by casting the string to an int for `\PDOException`
resolution.author: atomiix

ticket.title: Shop associations for cart_rules are saved without taking into account the employee permissions
ticket.bug:
In a multishop environment, when selecting all available shop in Shop selection, nothing is saved to `ps_cart_rule_shop`, or if there are entries, they are deleted. This is correct if the employee has access to all shop. It is wrong if not.

**Case 1:**
An employee has access to only one shop. If he creates a cart rule, it is valid in all shops. There is no way to avoid this behavior.
This can have disastrous consequences: If the employee does not understand what he does, he can offer free orders in any random shop. If shops are independent, this is a nightmare.

**Case 2:**
A cart rule is limited to one shop (created by an employee with permissions for more than one shop).
An other employee, that has only permissions in that shop, views the cart rule and saves it without changes.
Now the cart rule is corrupted, and applies to all shops.

**Case 3:**
A cart rule is limited to one shop. An employee with access to two shops adds the second shop and saves it. Now the cart rule is valid in all shops, and the checkbox `shop restriction` has been removed (what represents an error).
ticket.expected:
I expect, that the shop associations of a cart rule reflect the permissions of the creator of the rule. There must be no possible permission escalation.

**Case 1:**
If an employee is restricted to a set of shops, all cart rules he creates must be restricted to shops inside that set.

**Case 2:**
If a cart rule is limited to a set of shops, these shop associations must not change, unless there is a explicit action by the user.

**Case 3:**
If `Shop restriction` is checked, it must not be removed. A cart rule associated to two shops must remain associated to the two shops, unless there is a explicit action by the user.
ticket.steps:
Setup:
- Multishop environment with at least three shops
- Edit or create a employee profile with permissions for cart rules, and use this profile for creating two employees as follows:
- An employee A that has permissions only for shop A
- An employee B that has permissions for shop A and B

**Case 1:**
1. Log in as employee A
2. Create a cart rule
3. Note that there is no option to select `Shop restriction` in the conditions tab 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/162452737-0c30e332-7647-4a65-b157-3c818eb5ef4c.png)
4. Log in as super admin
5. Find the new cart rule, click on `Edit`
6. In the conditions tab > note that the cart rule has no `Shop restriction` and is valid in all shops.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/162452982-80e2717a-bb57-4b4b-9878-550c0c705eae.mp4


**Case 2:**
1. Log in as super admin
2. Create a cart rule restricted to shop A
3. Log in as user A
4. View the cart rule, do not make any modification, and click on `Save`
5. Log in as super admin
6. Note that the shop restriction has been removed from the cart rule

**Case 3:**
1. Log in as user B
2. Create a cart rule restricted to shop A
3. Edit the cart rule
4. Add shop B to the shop restrictions, click `Save and stay`
5. Note that `Shop restrictions` has been unchecked
6. You can note the same thing as super admin

resolution.title: Fix cart rule shop association
resolution.description: The shop association of a cart rule is filled automatically, if an employee is restricted to certain shops and does not select himself shop associated to the cart rule. Never uncheck `shop association` if a shop is already selected. If we check a simple restriction, but do not select an item, an error is raised.
resolution.how_to_test: All three cases explained in #28148 are no longer possible to reproduce
resolution.author: lmeyer1

ticket.title: Notice: Trying to access array offset on value of type bool
ticket.bug:
Any module or function that uses the native core PrestaShop function "isDiscounted" from the Product class will rise a Notice because an uncontrolled condition inside that function that rely that you have a cart already, but in many cases you will not.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5998908/155170380-183265df-987b-445f-843d-26a64e7aea09.png)

So, the simple thing is to make the condition with if "$ids" is not false (that is the return of evaluating the context cart id_address into the Address::getCountryAndState without really a cart)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5998908/155170816-fbddbf92-16c0-4bf0-a433-f3ec76625330.png)

Of course the "problem" appear when debug mode is on.

Anyway, this produce a lot of lines into the error_log.
ticket.expected: Not any warning.
ticket.steps:
1.- Install a module or create an script that uses the "Product::isDiscounted" function and hooked/executed on a display front hook
1a.- For example https://addons.prestashop.com/es/informes-estadisticas/18739-pixel-plus-eventos-api-de-conversiones-catalogo.html or 
[wim_test27774.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/8141510/wim_test27774.zip)

2.- Enable debug mode or tail your error_log

3.- Visit any product of your store without a cart (new visitor).

4.- Execution stopped with debug mode on or a lot of lines into the error log.

resolution.title: Avoid Notice: Trying to access array offset on value of type bool
resolution.description: When you don't have a cart already yet, any module or script that uses this function raises a Notice: Trying to access array offset on value of type bool, because Address::getCountryAndState could return an array with the id_country, or if the cart is false, the address also and the function return a false, that is not correct evaluated into the next line (only take account that is returning an array)
resolution.how_to_test: On the issue #27774 is explained how to test it.
resolution.author: danidomen

ticket.title: [Multistore] - Product on category page display out of stock flag instead of availlable on order
ticket.bug:
>Edited by Khouloud Steps to reproduce the issue: 1. Enable Multistore & Create new Group shop with Share quantity = enabled 2. Create a shop assiciated to this Group shop 3. Create a product with quantity = 0 & allowed for order 4. Go to FO of the shop2 > Category list 5. See error > The product is displayed with out-of-stock flag ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/153606126-320f965a-e2e0-4302-b44a-9dd91f947656.png) Hello, i'm back with my bug and i found the cause: On catagory page i have product display as out of stock even if the product is availlable for order. But if I access to the product page, status is ok and product can be added on cart. More, when I add the product to cart, the status on category page change for the good status until the product are removed from the cart. Not all product are affected. I searched in code and the problem come from the out_of_sotck parameter to define if you can order product out of stock. For some product the value of out_of_stock is empty on category page instead of 0,1 or 2. In this case it should be 1. **Product.php line 5579:** ` $row['allow_oosp'] = Product::isAvailableWhenOutOfStock($row['out_of_stock']);` Problem is only on category page. Home page, product page, search page are ok. To avoid loosing customer i disable message on category page ![123515636-7b7b8e00-d698-11eb-853f-76c3ce5b1a0c](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675137-c44cd4ee-ffaf-4ccd-960f-0c635e5b574b.png) ![128632685-d1507f7f-9bf3-4c52-8459-34b62a81d6ac](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675149-ebaed18e-23ac-48ef-9cbf-82baae25733f.png) ![128632731-46a0e0c9-5313-4dec-85c8-4040db14b05a](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675154-59fd6ed0-5b2b-4ae7-8363-faadd7b23f43.png) ![128632843-5d73b17b-3530-48b5-939e-0583711376be](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675158-4444a40f-40ce-4183-8e0b-edaba510dff0.png) I try to come back on the classic theme to identify if the problem occurs too. At first glance, no message is displaying and it seems to be normal. But classic theme doesn't display out of stock or allows order by default. If stock equal 0, no message is displayed. I try with not allow and allow order: **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach}
{/block} ``` But if i add the check on allow on order (product.allow_oosp) and display message, we can see that property is not initialize with correct value on catalog part and availability message is wrong : **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {if $product.quantity > 0} {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach} {else} {if !$product.allow_oosp}
  • {$product.availability_message}
    • {/if} {/if}
{/block} ``` **Root cause :** After a long investigation, i found that : On class ProductAssemblerCore (ProductAssembler.php in classes foler), there is a SQL request that seach information for product. This request seach stock information by product shop and don't take account that stock is configurated to share stock 👍 ``` LEFT JOIN {$prefix}stock_available sa ON sa.id_product = p.id_product AND sa.id_shop = $idShop ``` ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675471-d815e5f1-9383-4833-ae81-d25d5d5c89ac.png) So on category page for shared stock management between shop, information about stock are wrong

**You need to have multishop with shared product stock** 

1. Define product witch capability to be order even if stock are equal to 0
2. Define stock to 0
3. Show product on category page
4. Flag is out of stock instead of On-demand

ticket.title: An unexpected error occurred when you try to modify any customer information after the import
ticket.bug:
Error `An unexpected error occurred. [PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Domain\Customer\Exception\CustomerException code 0]: Customer contains invalid field values` when modify and save customer information in BO. 

Error arrive because of invalid value of field `date_add" = 0000-00-00 00:00:00`.  If change this value to real date directly in DB, error disappear.  When we import customers, **Registration date** is used for `date_add`, so autodate is `false`, and `date_upd` is `0000-00-00 00:00:00`. Why not to set `date_upd` => `date('Y-m-d H:i:s')`, in `self::$default_values` in AdminImportController.php ?
ticket.expected: No error when save customer information.
ticket.steps:
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to **Advanced Parameters** - **Import** , and import **Customers**. You can use sample **csv** file. 
2. Go to **Customers** page, open Edit customer page.
3. Try to save customer information. Not necessary to modify something.
4. See error `An unexpected error occurred. [PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Domain\Customer\Exception\CustomerException code 0]: Customer contains invalid field values`.
If customer is created directly in **BO** or **FO**, there is no such error.

**Screenshots**

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4932192/118986011-44baa580-b97f-11eb-9f28-740801d7d474.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4932192/118986636-d0343680-b97f-11eb-80ca-ae7b6449bdcf.png)

resolution.title: Fixes error which occurred when you try to modify any customer information after the import
resolution.description: Fix issue : https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/24583 - Add default value for customer 'date_upd' while importing new customers. - Please note that to reproduce this bug you must import customers and have "Registration date" in the columns.
resolution.how_to_test: 1) Import customer(s) with "Registration date" filled.    2) Edit customer in back office (with or without modification) 3) Save customer ------------------------------------------------------- Before fix  : An unexpected error occurred. [CustomerException code 0]: Customer contains invalid field values ------------------------------------------------------- After fix : Customer is saved without errors

ticket.title: Too many queries to test if address_id exists
ticket.bug:
When there is a product in the cart and I'm not logged in, Prestashop is repeating this query 30 times

    SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE `id_address`  FROM ps_address a  WHERE a.`id_address` = 0 LIMIT 1

Additionally the logic is suspect, because the query does not check if the address is marked as deleted or if it is active. This would be necessary, since the addresses are soft-deleted in the address table.

The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page. Checking the individual queries in Stopwatch SQL shows that all queries are exactly the same.

![2021-11-25_161510](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143466190-ec24be8e-1271-4f87-b7ba-304fa80108d8.jpg)
ticket.expected:
Never check if address with `id_address = 0` exists. It must never exist.
Check only once if an address exists, remember the answer.
Even better: good execution logic would test only once for the existence of the address saved in the cart.

To-do:

- [x] #28321

- [ ]  Investigate the core of the issue to understand: why we are doing so much queries (related to how we store the adress in the cache of the cart) ?
ticket.steps:
1. Enable Profiling mode
3. Add a product to your cart
4. Scroll down to query doubles, you'll notice that there is 30x the same query on the table `address`.

resolution.title: Don't check if an invalid address exists over and over again
resolution.description: It's no use checking if an id_address <= 0 exists.
resolution.how_to_test: Enable profiling mode, look for the query described in the issue, see it's not there.
resolution.author: eternoendless

resolution.title: Do not pad ps_versions_compliancy for PrestaShop >= 8
resolution.description: When the constructor of a module is called, the `ps_versions_compliancy` property gets padded with missings `.0` or `.999` (`1.7.3` becomes `1.7.3.0` for min and `1.7.3.999` for max). Since PrestaShop 8 get rid of the first `1`, the implemented logic doesn't work and add a missing `.0` or `.999` when it shouldn't. This PR fixes the issue by not padding the `ps_versions_compliancy` property when the version starts with `8` or above.
resolution.author: atomiix

ticket.title: Filter in movements and stock does not reset
ticket.bug: When filters are activated on Movements (or Stock) page, if you change tab to "Stock" (or Movement, you got the idea...), and then go back to "Movements", the filters appears to be reset (at "None", all checkboxes unchecked), but if you add a new filter, it will combine with the older filters.
ticket.expected: Filters should either be really reset, or filters should stay displayed.
ticket.steps:
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to BO > Catalog > Stocks > Movements : All movements are displayed
2. Add Filter, for example "Movement type" set to "Product return" : Data are filtered
3. Go to "Stock" tab, then go back to "Movements" : All movements are displayed, and filters appears to be reset.
4. Add another filter (for example, check "Accessories" category) : Only data with "Accessories" category AND movement type "Product return" are displayed, even if there is no shown filter on movement type.

**Screenshots**

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Q6UXU9rspcWKQPgaEKEzgZGBJkzwNvam/view?usp=sharing

resolution.title: Fix filters reset in BO stock movements
resolution.description: In BO/Catalog/Stock, filters didn't reset correctly because previous selection was kept stored in child components. Only the root app did reset its own filters on reset event. Now the root app resets itself plus its child filter components.
resolution.how_to_test:
1. Go to BO > Catalog > Stocks > Movements : All movements are displayed
  2. Add Filter, for example "Movement type" set to "Product return" : Data are filtered
  3. Go to "Stock" tab, then go back to "Movements" : All movements are displayed, and filters appears to be reset.
  4. Add another filter (for example, check "Accessories" category) : Only data with "Accessories" category AND movement type "Product return" are displayed, even if there is no shown filter on movement type.
resolution.author: saulaski

resolution.title: Remove useless legacyContextLoader
resolution.description: During the upgrade using the autoupgrade module, the database is upgraded with a Symfony command. To be able to execute this command, all commands (services tagged with `console.command`) are added to the Symfony container. As `LegacyContextLoader::LoadGenericContext();` is called in the command's constructor, it resets the context employee even if we don't use the command. The problem is that we need to have a valid employee with enough rights to enable the theme during the upgrade process, just after the db upgrade. This PR Solve the issue by simply removing the `LegacyContextLoader` as it doesn't seem useful.
resolution.author: atomiix

ticket.title: Error in Front controller when checkAccess() returns false
ticket.bug: While documenting the flow of Front controllers, I found a rather peculiar call path: ![Weird call path](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1009343/147365412-71aace00-8c27-4991-9801-d562c37d995c.png) As of 1.7.8, Front controllers [systematically call `displayMaintenancePage()`](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L493). This method will display the maintenance page and exit [only if the maintenance mode is activated](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L763). Otherwise, it will let the flow of execution continue. The execution flow (standard for front and back) will then call the `checkAccess()` method, theoretically [to determine if the current user can access the page or not](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/Controller.php#L155). In admin controllers, this will check the XSRF token. In Front controllers, this [returns returns true by default](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L247) (except in AuthController, where it [will redirect if the user is already logged in](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L247)). The standard behavior of controllers is to call `initCursedPage()` when `checkAccess()` returns false. In Admin controllers, this will [display the "invalid token" page](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/AdminController.php#L2288) that we all know and love. In Front controllers, oddly, this [redirects the flow to `displayMaintenancePage()`](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L611) again, although at this point in we already know that the site is not in maintenance mode. This means that execution flow will always continue, leading to this error: For all we know, this bug might be at least 10 years old, and it only happens when `checkAccess()` returns false **and** the shop is not in maintenance mode.
ticket.expected: I expected to get an "access forbidden" error message.
ticket.steps: This can be reproduced easily by modifying `FrontController::checkAccess()` to make it return false instead of true (like a custom controller would do). After having modified this, access any Front office URL and you will get the error.
ticket.versions: I think this affects all versions since at least 1.5

resolution.title: Fix forbidden access page in Front Office
resolution.description: There is a logic error in Front controllers described in the original ticket. This change fixes the bug by using the already existing, but unused, "forbidden" template.
resolution.how_to_test: See issue to reproduce. With the PR, you get a nice error message instead of a crash.
resolution.author: eternoendless

ticket.title: Problem with orders with amounts without decimals
ticket.expected: The order is marked with the correct status
ticket.steps:
1. Install clean Prestashop versión >= 1.7.8.0.
2. Create currency without decimal and set as default.
3. Install the `Payment by check` and enable it or use a payment method that set the status of payment in `payment accepted (ps_order_state id 2)` or `Processing in progress (ps_order_state id 3)`.
3. Create an publish product with price lower than $1000.
4. Create and publish product with price higher than $1000.
5. Buy a product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with a price less than $ 1000. It should work fine.
6. Purchase product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with price higher than $1000. This will fail and set order to Payment Error state.

resolution.title: Avoid using _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_
resolution.description: PaymentModule::validateOrder is using the deprecated config constant `_PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_` to generate a string representation of the total amount paid with a payment module and comparing that to the cart total string representation calculated with `Context::getContext()->getComputingPrecision()`. This check will always fail when a currency with a decimal precision is different than the present `_PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_ = 2` constant, hence the order will be placed in a payment error status and no log or further details will be displayed. This happens for example while using MercadoPago payment module v4.8.0 (official partner). Apparently _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_ was deprecated in 1.7.7.x but this core class still uses it. The proposed change substitutes the constant with the precision value obtained from the context, just like it is used in the rest of the source code. Also a log is added to register this error situation.
resolution.how_to_test: Create a currency with decimal values different than "2", make a purchase in the FO, order is created with status Configuration::get('PS_OS_ERROR') instead of a valid one. Full details in bug report.
resolution.author: mpaolino

resolution.title: Improved session availability test
resolution.description: The core PHP session test of PrestaShop checks if the sessions directory is writable, which does not always work as expected. Combined with an `open_basedir` configured without the `session.save_path`, PHP sessions are still working as intended, but the test_sessions function fails. In such a case, the One Click Upgrade module will fail checking its prerequisites in an attempt to make an upgrade. A fix was already opened for the autoupgrade module itself, but it should be also fixed in the core.
resolution.how_to_test: Have a PrestaShop 1.6 or higher. Configure open_basedir and don't include session.save_path. Go to Module list > Upgrade One Click Upgrade to 4.15.0 > Configure the module, then see the error.

ticket.title: Unable to add a first address with error "Invalid postcode" in some circumstances
ticket.bug:

![Immagine 2023-01-20 115746](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/213679356-6c368d48-b47a-4077-a00e-f31ac4f68664.png)

This bug happens in this circumstances
- Multishop installation
- Main shop has default country `France`, second shop has default country `Switzerland`
- `France` is not associated to second shop, `Switzerland` is not associated to main shop

resolution.title: Always use id_country from request if provided

resolution.title: Fix widget call for nonexistent modules

ticket.title: is_logged property in FO is true even for guests
ticket.bug:
Something is broken on 8.0 and develop - guest customers haves `is_logged = true` for some reason.

This results in wrong behavior of modules that use it. For example, ps_customersignin returns a logged in customer with no name and a list of non-functional links. The same for customer account links in footer.

`$customer` object in front office should NOT return `is_logged` `true` in case of guests.

I traced the behavior to `$customer->isLogged` function, there is a difference, when 8+ returns true for `Context::getContext()->cookie->isSessionAlive()` call. This change is probably correct.

What is not correct is the call. `$cust['is_logged'] = $this->context->customer->isLogged(true);`. Changing it to `$cust['is_logged'] = $this->context->customer->isLogged();` fixes the issue.

And when you click them, it redirects you to login page. Also if you check the dumped data on the top, see that the customer has `logged_in` true or 1.

ticket.title: Enabling new theme fails due to routes caching
ticket.bug:
If you upload theme via `Theme & design page -> new theme ->  Import from your computer` in Back Office and try to enable it, you get an error mentioning some non-existing routes. (depends if theme related modules have symfony generated routes).
For example if you have some other theme enabled, and you try to enable the classic theme agaub, you get error saying `An exception has been thrown during the rendering of a template ("Unable to generate a URL for the named route "blockwishlist_configuration" as such route does not exist.").`
You can manually run bin/console c:c command in terminal to clean symfony cache and the page starts working again. So probably some automated sf cache clear is missing when enabling theme.
![Screenshot from 2022-10-14 14-44-47](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31609858/195840069-f7bce568-7228-4810-96a5-3bff740d3065.png)

resolution.title: Module from theme with tab using SF routing fails after enabling the theme
resolution.description: When a theme installs a module that contains a tab with route_name it redirects to the theme index right away But for the route to be usable the cache needs to be cleared, this operation is handled in a shutdown callback which is why when the page is refreshed at first the cache still has not been cleared yet This results in an exception as the route can not be found, to avoid this blocking exception during the menu rendering we catch the `RouteNotFoundException` and the associated tab is not rendered, after a few seconds when the cache is cleared the page can be refreshed and the tab will be displayed appropriately Additionally during the tests it was found that the INSTALL event for module is triggered even when it failed, this can result in unwanted added tab even if the module failed to install, so now the event is only triggered on install success  **Note**: this is not an ideal fix but so far I didn't find a proper way to correctly clear the cache without causing side effects bugs on refresh
resolution.author: jolelievre
