ticket.title: PS 8.0.1. class/Customer.php function getSimpleAddressSql() generates incorrect SQL
ticket.bug:
In 8.0.1 was added ORDER BY expression to class/Customer.php function getSimpleAddressSql().
But it was not considered next optional adding expression for filtering by id_address.
Condition "AND a.`id_address` = xxx" ignored because of incorrect SQL statement "ORDER BY a.`alias` AND a.`id_address` = xxx":

```
SELECT DISTINCT
                      a.`id_address` AS `id`,
                      a.`alias`,
                      a.`firstname`,
                      a.`lastname`,
                      a.`company`,
                      a.`address1`,
                      a.`address2`,
                      a.`postcode`,
                      a.`city`,
                      a.`id_state`,
                      s.name AS state,
                      s.`iso_code` AS state_iso,
                      a.`id_country`,
                      cl.`name` AS country,
                      co.`iso_code` AS country_iso,
                      a.`other`,
                      a.`phone`,
                      a.`phone_mobile`,
                      a.`vat_number`,
                      a.`dni`
                    FROM `ps_address` a
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_country` co ON (a.`id_country` = co.`id_country`)
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_country_lang` cl ON (co.`id_country` = cl.`id_country`)
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_state` s ON (s.`id_state` = a.`id_state`)
                     INNER JOIN ps_country_shop country_shop
        ON (country_shop.id_country = co.id_country AND country_shop.id_shop = 1)
                    WHERE
                        `id_lang` = 1
                        AND `id_customer` = 2
                        AND a.`deleted` = 0
                        AND a.`active` = 1
                    ORDER BY a.`alias` AND a.`id_address` = 16663
```
And as result will be selected all the customer addresses, but not the one filtered by id_address.
ticket.expected:
function getSimpleAddressSql() should return one selected address filtered by id_address. 
Correct generated SQL code should be the following:
```
SELECT DISTINCT
                      a.`id_address` AS `id`,
                      a.`alias`,
                      a.`firstname`,
                      a.`lastname`,
                      a.`company`,
                      a.`address1`,
                      a.`address2`,

                      a.`other`,
                      a.`phone`,
                      a.`phone_mobile`,
                      a.`vat_number`,
                      a.`dni`
                    FROM `ps_address` a
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_country` co ON (a.`id_country` = co.`id_country`)
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_country_lang` cl ON (co.`id_country` = cl.`id_country`)
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_state` s ON (s.`id_state` = a.`id_state`)
                     INNER JOIN ps_country_shop country_shop
        ON (country_shop.id_country = co.id_country AND country_shop.id_shop = 1)
                    WHERE
                        `id_lang` = 1
                        AND `id_customer` = 2
                        AND a.`deleted` = 0
                        AND a.`active` = 1
                        AND a.`id_address` = 16663
                    ORDER BY a.`alias`
```

ticket.title: Customization value lost after combination change, leading to customization mess
ticket.bug: If our store has a product with customization and combination options and a customer, in the product page, first adds a customization and then changes the combination, the ID of the combination changes to "0" ("product_customization_id" input) and some weird stuff can be done, like having in the cart a product that has a mandatory combination without it, or having a product with two customizations. In the steps to reproduce, I show some examples of this behavior and if you read that section you will understand the problem.
ticket.expected: When we add the same product twice but with two different customizations, two products should appear in the cart with one customization each, and when we delete one product, only one should remain with it's customization.
ticket.steps:
Create a customizable product and add some combinations (we used sample "Customizable mug" product, and added some size combinations). Product should look like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181243297-c8a3987c-4ea8-4a39-8570-fda75bb1c74e.png)
First, add a product customization (write some text and click "save customization") and then change the combination (order is the key).
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181248736-b44e1cef-8bf0-4c13-8156-5b2b338a0aa5.png)

If you inspect the input id="product_customization_id" you will see that value after the combination change has changed to "0", but customization is still shown to the user in the form above. If you refresh the page, product_customization_id value will be back to normal. But it is not only that, we can manage to do some weird stuff:

Let's start again: Access the product page, add some customization, change the combination and add the product to cart. Everything should look fine. Then repeat the process again. Add to the cart the same product with other customization and size (remember, first we have to select the customization and then change the combination).

Now the cart looks weird. We have two mugs but with two customizations each:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181244635-2dc5f660-f27f-4fe7-abd9-c8d3b64efecb.png)

If we try to delete one mug from the cart, we see that customizations dissapear, or even we can't remove one mug (at least in the interface, if we refresh the page, the cart is empty). This way we can manage to buy a customizable mug that has a mandatory customization without it.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181246225-69fd13d9-cd45-4e35-9471-148b818a2c5b.png)

Probably, more weird things can be done this way.

ticket.title: Hook actionObjectUpdateAfter - Infinite loop that leads to memory limit in FO
ticket.bug:
Hi,
i don't understand why the core is doing this but i'm facing an infinite loop when customer is loggedin but its totally logical if I read the code. First it was working but since I hooked a module on actionObjectUpdateAfter i get this syndrom.

I searched in code and this is what i found

When we are logged in as customer on front, 
It calls 
1. Hook::exec 
which check user logged in groups in Hook class with the method 
2. getHookModuleExecList who calls
3. getAllHookRegistrations.
This function calls 
4. $customer->isLogged() 
and this function calls 
5. Context::getContext()->cookie->isSessionAlive()
this function calls (on cookie class)
6. $this->getSession($this->session_id)
and the getSession method calls 
7. $session->save() 
who calls in object model the 
8. update() method who calls the 
9. hook actionObjectUpdateAfter who tried to Hook::exec 
then restart this infinite loop (back to 1.) .

I succed to stop this look by adding in objectModel line 864 

```
if(get_class($this) != 'EmployeeSession' && get_class($this) != 'CustomerSession'){
	Hook::exec('actionObjectUpdateAfter', ['object' => $this]);
	Hook::exec('actionObject' . $this->getFullyQualifiedName() . 'UpdateAfter', ['object' => $this]);
}
```
But with this it breaks the hook actionObjectUpdateAfter on EmployeeSession class and CustomerSession which extends ObjectModel too...

Edit : I figured out that natively (I mean when fresh install prestashop) this hook is not in database and is added only once a module is attached to this hook ( actionObjectUpdateAfter ) si until the hook doesn't appear in ps_hook table there is not this issue but when the row exists in ps_hook we got an infinite loop....
ticket.expected: We can't have an infinite loop...
ticket.steps:
1. I attached a module on actionObjectUpdateAfter but the module is uninstalled since (i don't know if it is linked to this i checked on DB there is no more entries of attached module on this hook) ...
2. I logged in in front and i get a max execution time with a random location of killing process.. (it's never the same end position)

resolution.title: Remove inifinite loop on actionObjectUpdateAfter hook
resolution.description: remove inifinite loop on actionObjectUpdateAfter hook
resolution.author: lartist

ticket.title: Hidden CMS category is displayed in breadcrumb and gives error 404
ticket.bug:
In Prestashop, a CMS category can be hidden, and contain displayed CMS pages.
This makes sense. Maybe we want to show a link to a CMS page, but we don't want to display the list of all pages in the same CMS category. To achieve this, we can set `Display: Yes` for the page and `Display: No` for the CMS category.

But, in this case, the breadcrumb is not correct: In fact the Breadcrumb contains a link to the CMS category, and clicking on it gives a not found error.
ticket.expected: If a CMS category is set to `Display: No` and the page to `Display: Yes`, the breadcrumb of that page should not show the hidden category. Instead of `Home > Hidden category > Page title`, it should simply read `Home > Page title`.
ticket.steps:
1. Go to the BO, menu `Appearance - Pages`
2. Create a new category with name `Secret name` and select `Display: No`.
3. In that category, create a new page with title `New Page` and select `Display: Yes`.
4. In the FO, navigate to the new page
 => notice that the breadcrumb displays `Home > Secret name > New Page`
5. Click on `Secret name` 
 =>You get a 404 not found error

resolution.title: Only show active CMS categories in breadcrumb
resolution.description: An inactive CMS category must not be displayed in the CMS page's breadcrumb.
resolution.how_to_test: Follow the setup instruction in #29539. The breadcrumb must show up correctly (without hidden category).

resolution.title: Clear translations cache before translating fixtures

ticket.title: Duplicated join in Hook.php leads to inefficient query
ticket.bug:
Quite a slow query is in `classes/Hook.php:1202` 

![Immagine 2022-08-15 154249](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/184646838-18b7779b-063b-4620-b6e3-3dd7b2f1a5ef.png)

In the following query, `ps_module_shop` is joined twice, but only one join is needed.
``` 
SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE h.`name` as hook, m.`id_module`, h.`id_hook`, m.`name` as module
FROM `ps_module` m
INNER JOIN ps_module_shop module_shop
ON (module_shop.id_module = m.id_module AND module_shop.id_shop = 2 AND module_shop.enable_device & 1)
INNER JOIN `ps_module_shop` `ms` ON ms.`id_module` = m.`id_module`
INNER JOIN `ps_hook_module` `hm` ON hm.`id_module` = m.`id_module`
INNER JOIN `ps_hook` `h` ON hm.`id_hook` = h.`id_hook`
LEFT JOIN `ps_module_group` `mg` ON mg.`id_module` = m.`id_module`
WHERE (h.`name` != "paymentOptions") AND (hm.`id_shop` = 2) AND (mg.id_shop = 2 AND  mg.`id_group` IN (3))
GROUP BY hm.id_hook, hm.id_module
ORDER BY hm.`position`
```
ticket.expected:
I expect queries to be optimized. 

Removing the extraneous join, the query is faster (half the time, only 2 ms, that is not much, but it is a tiny improvement).
![Immagine 2022-08-15 155107](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/184648092-8cd9baef-01b5-4c8b-97e0-51df70910c57.png)
ticket.steps:
1. Enable Debug profiler
2. Look for the query above on any page of the FO
3. Notice, that the table `ps_module_shop` is joined twice, and
    a. the extraneous (second) join is less restrictive than the first, but rows joined by the second query are a strict superset of those joined by the first query
    b. the alias `ms` is never used, neither in selected field, nor in conditions, nor elsewhere

resolution.title: Duplicated join in query.
resolution.description: Removes a duplicated inner join in a query
resolution.author: lmeyer1

ticket.title: Uploading the same version of a running module fails on 8.0
ticket.bug:
Hello :wave: 

I found a change of behavior in the module manager when we upgrade a module.

On PrestaShop v8, reuploading the same version of a module fails. I encountered this issue while uploading changes to test on a module without bumping its version.
When an upgrade fails or triggers an exception, there is an automatic action that disables the module.

In consequence even if my module is valid, I get the most generic error and my module is disabled. As we are currently on the compliancy with PrestaShop v8, I was assuming that our module was still breaking the shop.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6768917/182605131-24c4c22b-1e8c-4fee-98ea-f59971c14628.png)


**The concerned code was like this on 1.7.x:**
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/14cb6a4c6e72c55c16a95cfbe4aeb8e44fe73ab5/src/Adapter/Module/ModuleDataUpdater.php#L113-L117
(We could refacto this to always return `true`)

**And like this on 8.x :**
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/79b15c0b0ad54e6eafc58841ecf3f889957b9384/src/Core/Module/ModuleManager.php#L348

Was this change of behavior expected?
ticket.expected:
The zip upload should succeed, even if there is upgrade scripts to run or version to upgrade in the database.

ticket.title: Bad default value for "Product::pack_stock_type" - Inheritance issue when loading Pack class (that inherit Product)
ticket.bug:
The default value of Product::pack_stock_type is set as "Pack::STOCK_TYPE_DEFAULT;" which in turn has a default value PackStockType::STOCK_TYPE_DEFAULT.

This is an inheritance issue because Pack class inherit product so when a Pack class is instantiated before the class loader attempt to load the Product class. Before of all the class loader assign valued to class field and the value from Product::pack_stock_type is a field of Pack ... that is the class i attempt to instantiate at the beginning..

In normal situation this issue pass unnoticed because in class_index.php the class is loaded by alphabetic order but is pure luck.
In certain specific situation this may conduce to an error of "ClassNotFoundException".
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9608268/178926510-92a88007-89bf-44f3-9577-f2c56f1c8e5e.png)

The solution is to load directly the default value as "Product::pack_stock_type = PackStockType::STOCK_TYPE_DEFAULT;".

in fact all the other fields of products ha similar default value ex:
public $out_of_stock = OutOfStockType::OUT_OF_STOCK_DEFAULT;
public $redirect_type = RedirectType::TYPE_NOT_FOUND;

resolution.title: Change default assignation of Product::pack_stock_type
resolution.description: changed default assignation of Product::pack_stock_type for exclude loading error of Pack class (inheritance issue).
resolution.author: abramofranchetti

ticket.title: Inefficient queries in PrestaShopCollection, incoherent display of category names in breadcrumbs.
ticket.bug:
There is a bug in PrestaShopCollection is inefficient in a multishop context when a language file `*_lang` is involved, and there is one language entry per shop.

Verifiable example: 
If a category has not the same name in all shops, the name displayed in the breadcrumb is always the name of the category in the main shop.

The reason behind: the join generated selects all lines, and not the ones related to the current shop. 

e.g. The query generated for the category breadcrumbs in `ProductController::getBreadcrumbLinks()` (`$categoryDefault->getAllParents()`) returns too many lines:
```
SELECT * FROM `ps_category` a0 LEFT JOIN `ps_category_lang` `a1` ON (a0.`id_category` = a1.`id_category`) WHERE (a0.`nleft` < 2328) AND (a0.`nright` > 2337) AND (a1.`id_lang` = 1) ORDER BY a0.`nleft` asc
```
Given `nl` as category level depth, and `ns` the number of shops, the query returns `nl * ns` lines whereas it should return only `nl` lines, one for each category.

Note: this is related to #28841, which is not reproducible.
ticket.expected:
I expect 
1. the query to be efficient
2. `PrestaShopCollection` returning the objects pertaining to the current shop and not the main shop.
ticket.steps:
In a multishop environment:
1. In the BO, select a shop different from the main shop, `shop A`
2. Go to `Catalog - Categories`
3. Edit the name of a parent category that has a child category
4. In the FO, in `shop A`, navigate to a product being member of the child category
5. Notice that the name of the parent category displayed in the breadcrumb is the one of the main shop, and not the one of `shop A`

PS: We have a 26 shops in our multishop environment, so the performance is also a problem, but it would not be possible to observe it directly.

resolution.title: PrestashopCollection needs a shop restriction
resolution.description: Fixes the join of `multilang_shop` tables in `PrestShopCollection`. Both a problem of localization and performance.
resolution.author: lmeyer1

ticket.title: Too many queries to test if address_id exists
ticket.bug:
When there is a product in the cart and I'm not logged in, Prestashop is repeating this query 30 times

    SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE `id_address`  FROM ps_address a  WHERE a.`id_address` = 0 LIMIT 1

Additionally the logic is suspect, because the query does not check if the address is marked as deleted or if it is active. This would be necessary, since the addresses are soft-deleted in the address table.

The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page. Checking the individual queries in Stopwatch SQL shows that all queries are exactly the same.

![2021-11-25_161510](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143466190-ec24be8e-1271-4f87-b7ba-304fa80108d8.jpg)
ticket.expected:
Never check if address with `id_address = 0` exists. It must never exist.
Check only once if an address exists, remember the answer.
Even better: good execution logic would test only once for the existence of the address saved in the cart.

To-do:

- [x] #28321

- [ ]  Investigate the core of the issue to understand: why we are doing so much queries (related to how we store the adress in the cache of the cart) ?
ticket.steps:
1. Enable Profiling mode
3. Add a product to your cart

ticket.title: Unefficient retreival of $this->id_lang in class Cart
ticket.bug:
I discovered this bug in Profiling mode, see screenshot :
![2021-11-29_100258](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143838392-e45b986d-508a-46a7-8a28-b1c82a3dfd68.jpg)
The class *Cart* instantiates 40x an object model *Language*, always the current language. Not only one time would suffice, but looking at the code, each time it is the code `$this->getAssociatedLanguage()->getId()` that is implicated.
`ObjectModel::getAssociatedLanguage` loads the Language object model referenced in `$this->id_lang` (see https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/classes/ObjectModel.php#L379), but we only use the id of that model.

The bug consist of using `$this->getAssociatedLanguage()->getId()` instead of the straight forward `$this->id_lang`.
ticket.expected: I expect that when an object property is directly accessible, like `$this->id_lang`, we use it, instead of going for a convoluted, ressource intensive solution.
ticket.steps:
1. Enable Profiling mode
2. Display a FO page while having an article in the cart
3. Scroll down to Profiling section *ObjectModel instances*
4. Notice the number of times a language object model is instantiated (43x in my case, of which 40x in `classes/Cart.php`)

resolution.title: Cart: replace this->getAssociatedLanguage()->getId() by equivalent th…
resolution.description: Inefficient access of $this->id_lang. using inefficient $this->getAssociatedLanguage()->getId() instead of straight forward member access.

3. Generate some random combinations (for example with 2 colors and 2 sizes).
4. Set the combinations stock quantity so that the sum of the total quantity for an specific attribute is equal or less than 0. For example, in the image, color Naranja (Orange) combinations sum up 0.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/143493324-843ecf63-1cb2-47b0-86cb-3227bec40b26.png)
Note that the "Behavior when out of stock" option is set to "Deny orders".
5. Go to check the product in front office. Naranja (Orange) color should be available on selectors at least for M size (with 1 as stock quantity), but is not displayed at all.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/143493589-745da14d-d14c-4911-a6ac-2fc9c58aee87.png)

resolution.title: Avoid including negative stock quantity values in attribute selector total quantity sum
resolution.description: Please read the discussion in the PR, especially the latest comments. When "Display unavailable attributes on the product page" option from Product Settings is set to No, if you have a product with some combinations with negative stock quantity, the attributes selectors showed in front office incorrectly hide some attributes that should be available for shopping. Avoid including negative stock quantity values in total quantity sum for attributes selector prevent this behaviour.
resolution.how_to_test: Reproduce the steps described on the issue #26763. For that specific example the Naranja (Orange) color will be displayed properly for M size attribute. ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/143495498-5765d7fc-1700-4966-b40d-19f29f495351.png)
resolution.author: prestaalba
